OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope (supported MIME types) of the connector.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_XTM_ONE_INTENT.description: XTM One intent for agent-based extraction.

IMPORT_DOCUMENT_AI_INCLUDE_RELATIONSHIPS.description: Whether to include relationships extracted from the document.

IMPORT_DOCUMENT_AI_CREATE_INDICATOR.description: Whether to flag extracted observables for indicator creation.

IMPORT_DOCUMENT_AI_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Import Document AI web service (legacy direct mode).

IMPORT_DOCUMENT_AI_API_KEY.description: PEM licence/certificate key used to authenticate against the web service (legacy direct mode).
